propositions: The review bot computes LLM token usage (_usage dict with input/output/cache/request counts) in the runner but currently discards it downstream, leaving zero token visibility in CloudWatch or artifacts.
Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent steps expose _usage on their outputs; _attach_code_review_metrics must aggregate these token fields across succeeded steps into coverage.metrics.

voter._publish_token_usage_metrics must emit five CloudWatch metrics (review_bot_llm_input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, total_tokens) to Namespace='rebar/host' with Unit='Count', best-effort and tolerant of boto3 failures.
A step record without _usage must contribute zero and not raise; the aggregation is additive and tolerant.
After a successful vote, review_and_vote must call the token publisher with the verdict's coverage.metrics to emit metrics, mirroring the existing error-metric publisher contract.
Pass-1 finder batch does not surface per-finder _usage on step outputs and requires a separate follow-up ticket to thread usage through the shared plan-review path.
